description: One-call domain vetting: RDAP age and status, DNS, MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM and an HTTPS probe combined into a 0-100 score, a low_risk/review/high_risk verdict and reason codes. Uncharged if a data source is down. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base. Calling without payment returns the payment requirement; invalid input is not charged.

domain.description: Domain to check, e.g. example.com. An email address or URL is reduced to its domain.
